findings.classification: validated test-contract mismatch; not a demonstrated production-function bug
findings.title: Reader AL fixtures do not form a coherent original normal-return integration path
findings.observed: First fixture obtains source_unavailable and supplies reader_result_al=true. Connected producer fixture obtains usable and supplies reader_result_al=false. The low-level API intentionally accepts orthogonal observations, but these pairs are not the normal return AL of that same read.
byte_support: 414FD82D e80ee60000 calls the reader; 414FD841 89c3 saves EAX; 414FD905 84db tests saved BL.
findings.action: Retain orthogonal-input fixtures as explicit local-contract tests, but add coherent read->consumer cases using the actual normal-read result (usable => AL=1, ordinary refusal => AL=0). Do not derive AL for outside_supported_domain/opaque or unknown original exits.
findings.focused_reproduction: review_baseline.py --run-tests confirms both fixture pairs and runs a separate 16-check sanitizer-enabled coherent normal-reader probe.
findings.limitation: No production caller bug is claimed. Existing fixtures are useful for input independence; they are insufficient by themselves for a connected original call-path claim.

findings.classification: missing focused composite regression coverage at baseline
findings.title: Producer/reader/actor marker-policy transitions are tested mostly in isolation
findings.observed: Baseline producer->reader chain covers a positive derived marker; later zero/NaN producer results are asserted without rereading. Reader policy cases and actor marker cases are separate fixtures, so the effects of reader policy clearing active versus later AL bypass are not jointly checked.
findings.action: Add focused coherent chains for produced 0/NaN under policy-enabled versus policy-bypassed reads, and a negative marker with normal usable versus source-unavailable reads. Assert status, AL assumption, active mutation, actor transition and unchanged sink on rejection. Do not expand to full lifecycle reconstruction.
findings.limitation: Each individual branch already has unit coverage; this finding is about composition, not evidence of incorrect branch code. The review probe adds coherent usable-zero and expired-zero/positive cases outside baseline tests, not the whole suggested matrix.

findings.classification: confirmed oracle-independence limitation; no failed behavioral test
findings.title: 2736 capacity checks compare structurally duplicated production/reference formulas
findings.observed: 144 wrapping-edge cases plus 2592 grid cases use reference_capacity, whose clamp, wrapping request, early return and selection branches repeat calculate_charge_capacity. Eight literal boundary cases and 18 raw-byte checks provide some separately specified expectations, but the 3170 count must not be presented as independent equivalence proof.
findings.action: Keep the broad grid; when charge changes land, add a few literal byte-anchored expectations for wrapping extremes and branch boundaries rather than a second copy of the same formula. No implementation-order claim or new target logic is needed.
findings.limitation: Independent oracle generation and full original equivalence are outside this review. Existing documentation already disclaims independent audit.
